name: KoCommonGEN v2
description: KoCommonGEN v2 is a fine-grained benchmark dataset focused on Korean commonsense reasoning. It comprises multiple-choice questions across seven error categories, including commonsense memorization, numerical commonsense, and toxic speech, designed to evaluate the reliability of large language models' commonsense reasoning capabilities in Korean.
reputation: A recent Korean commonsense benchmark that is gaining attention in Korean-language LLM evaluation, but it is not yet a widely established standard.
notes: Includes human annotations and categorizes errors into seven types; human accuracy ~85%, GPT-4 ~74%, other LLMs ~42%.
